scope: Package 2 Step Q — per-integration timeout/retry/lease boundaries; no invented global one-size retry schedule.

retry.backoff: Exponential plus bounded jitter; retry only when provider failure classifier marks retryable; invalid token is terminal.

policies.retry: Provider failure classification exists; exact per-operation retry counts/conditions must be verified per adapter before claiming all operations retry.

policies.idempotency: Provider request uses stable requestId as Idempotency-Key.

retry.calculation: Exponential backoff capped at 5 minutes; RIDEX_BACKEND_RESULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS must be a positive safe integer. TEST retains the default of 8 when omitted/invalid; PRODUCTION rejects missing or invalid configuration before claiming outbox work. No upper bound is introduced while RX-DEC-042 remains pending.

policies.lastFailure: Safe network/timeout codes or HTTP status codes only; raw network exception messages are not persisted.

decisionsPending.question: Approve an upper bound for RIDEX_BACKEND_RESULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS. Source requires an explicit positive safe integer in PRODUCTION before outbox work is claimed (TEST default remains 8); no maximum is guessed until review.

Approve upper bounds for Gateway signed config TTL, heartbeat/offline thresholds, SMS/call max-attempts and command expiry. Production now requires explicit positive signed-config values (and offlineAfterSeconds greater than heartbeat interval); no upper bounds are invented while this decision remains open.

requiredCrossComponentRules: Only retry failures explicitly classified transient/retryable; invalid credentials, invalid payloads and invalid device tokens are terminal or require configuration correction.
Timeout does not prove a remote operation did not happen; retries on financial/delivery actions must reuse stable idempotency identity.
Retry attempts, delay/backoff, request timeout and worker lease are separate settings; a lease must exceed the worker operation horizon or be renewed.
A terminal failure must remain inspectable and must not be deleted without an approved retention/cleanup policy.
Client cancellation/timeout cannot independently mark Backend authoritative booking/payment/trip state as failed.
Production multi-worker claim/retry semantics must use the approved authoritative store and be proven with concurrency/restart tests.
finalPhysicalTests: Push retries stop at configured bound and invalid token is terminal/deactivated.
Push provider timeout aborts request and records a safe failure classification.
Storage provider timeout/retry behavior matches each operation's approved policy.
Routing timeout and transient retry conditions do not multiply external requests unexpectedly.
Masked call timeout followed by retry reuses stable idempotency key.
Provider result timeout with remote success but lost response does not duplicate the Backend side effect.
Provider result outbox stops after approved max attempts and retains DEAD_LETTER.
Outbox backoff remains within the five-minute cap.
SMS/call lease expires only after approved lease duration and stale owners cannot finalize new claims.
Gateway signed config TTL and command expiry are bounded by the approved policy.
Invalid/unbounded environment values are safely rejected or clamped after approved policy is implemented.
Retries after process restart respect next-attempt time and dead-letter status.
Retry and timeout events are auditable without raw request URLs, credentials, recipient data or exception strings.
knownResidualsRequiringFinalReview: RX-DEC-042: configured Backend-result max attempts upper bound.
RX-DEC-043: Gateway signed config and command expiry/time threshold upper bounds.
Per-operation retryability of storage/routing/providers requires adapter-level review.
Cross-process worker leasing and remote outcome ambiguity require final physical tests.
